channel.title: The Grant Desk - Switzerland, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Switzerland, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 10 Aug 2026 (10 Aug to 16 Aug 2026).

  • transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 8 new grants - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
8 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 13 Jul 2026 (13 Jul to 19 Jul 2026).

  • TaDA Textile and Design Alliance: Artist in Residence Programme 2027 (Switzerland)
    https://tada-residency.ch/en/residence
    TaDA Textile and Design Alliance · deadline Closed 12 Aug 2026 · Funded residency: accommodation in Arbon a few minutes' walk from the workplace and the Bodensee, travel expenses, and a contribution to living costs, plus workspace at the Kreativzentrum ZIK (a former textile factory) and technology, knowledge and infrastructure support from 13 partner textile companies and research institutions. No application fee.
  • Emerging Talents: Concept Grant (Design)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/emerging-talents-concept-grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 10,000, plus possible individual coaching. No application fee.
  • Emerging Talents: Prototype Development (Design)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/emerging-talents-prototype-development
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 20,000, plus possible individual coaching. No application fee.
  • Emerging Talents: Production Grant (Design)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/emerging-talents-production-grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 50,000, conditional on own or third-party matching funding. No application fee.
  • Emerging Talents: Project Extension (Design)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/emerging-talents-project-extension
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 20,000, plus possible individual coaching. No application fee.
  • Emerging Talents: Matchmaking Event in Switzerland (Design)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/emerging-talents-matchmaking-event-in-switzerland
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Not a cash grant: participation in a one-day matchmaking event (keynote, lunch, matchmaking, networking) plus exclusive online pitch training. No application fee.
  • Game Design Emerging Talents: Pre-Production
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/game-design-emerging-talents-pre-production
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 20,000, plus possible additional coaching. No application fee.
  • Research Trip to Switzerland
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/research-trip-to-switzerland/
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline Rolling / undated · Accommodation, travel costs, and daily allowances covered, plus a local coach (a cultural professional from the Swiss artistic field) to facilitate networking and exchange. Applicants with childcare responsibilities can request up to CHF 1,000 per month toward childcare or children's travel expenses. No application fee.
